items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Green, the guy who owned the joint, said, 'Who is this?' I said, 'A friend of mine.'

ctx.x: Well, he was a great big fellow, I take it?

Yeah, but not only that, I mean the way he picked me up. I was strong, too. But, he wanted food. So I took him to the club. So Green, the guy who owned the joint, said, "Who is this?" I said, "A friend of mine." I mean, he's the owner of the club. (...) and at that time, they were serving food -- she was a tremendous cook -- Italian spaghetti at $1 a plate. So I took him upstairs and I said, "Well, Green, this your boy. ... Got him some food. I loved the band. I thought we had a helluva old band. I thought so.…
Oh, I see. You moved the piano out for protection.
